hero.title: Interview Assistant
hero.subtitle: Practice out loud. Get structured feedback.
hero.tagline: A FastAPI coach that transcribes a self-introduction and runs LangChain prompts for clarity, skills, sentiment, and interview practice chat.
hero.impact: Two routes do the work: /self_intro/ scores a spoken intro, and /interact/ classifies whether the user wants tips or is ready to practice.

problems.d: Rehearsing an interview alone gives no read on clarity, tone, or what to change.
A free-form chat reply is hard to act on. The scorer should return a fixed shape: clarity, feedback, character, skills, and sentiment.
A self-intro is spoken. The model needs a transcript before it can judge the content.
The same conversation has to tell “give me tips” apart from “I’m ready to speak.”

layers.title: FastAPI
layers.desc: CORS for an Angular client on port 4200. GET /, POST /self_intro/, POST /interact/

layers.title: AssemblyAI
layers.desc: The self-intro path transcribes a local audio file, then passes the text into the prompt

layers.title: LangChain + OpenAI
layers.desc: Templates for intro scoring, intent classification, tips, and a practice conversation

layers.title: Interact flow
layers.desc: Classify the query, then return chat tips or continue practice. Replies are parsed as JSON

highlights: POST /interact/ splits tips from live practice
LangChain prompt chains with a string output parser
AssemblyAI speech-to-text on the intro path
CORS opened for an Angular client on port 4200

stack.role: UI pointer; not vendored in this repo

status.label: Prompts for scoring, classification, tips, and conversation
